orphans.title: Leftover resources
orphans.description: Containers, volumes and certificates that no app or database accounts for. They are removed automatically once they stay orphaned past the grace period. Database data volumes are never removed.
orphans.empty: Nothing left over. Every container and volume belongs to a live app or database.

description.legacy: The built-in auth engine serves every request. Set APP_AUTH_ENGINE=shadow to compare it with the library without changing any behavior.
description.shadow: The built-in engine still decides. Bearer tokens are also checked by the library in the background and any disagreement is counted here.
description.library: The library serves the areas listed below. Set APP_AUTH_ENGINE back to legacy to roll back, no data is lost.

recoveryCodesNotice.title: Generate new recovery codes
recoveryCodesNotice.description: Your account moved to the new sign-in engine, and recovery codes issued before the move no longer work. Your authenticator app still does. Generate a fresh set so you can get back in if you lose your device.
